description: Per-operation virtual execution cost charged to the OpMode thread. A 'transaction' is one Lynx command/response round trip; the SDK blocks the calling thread for the round trip. Costs are means; each draw is lognormal with the listed sigma (log space) plus rare heavy-tail spikes.

provenance.basis: SDK 12.0 semantics (which calls issue LynxCommands, which are served from the bulk cache, which are cached host-side) are high confidence. Absolute microsecond values are community-reported Control Hub magnitudes (~1-3 ms per Lynx transaction, I2C register reads several ms) and must be calibrated with HardwareMonitor sessions (Sim/data/robot_profile.db in a team repo).

motor.setPower.note: DcMotorImplEx skips the command when power is unchanged

motor.getPower.note: issues GetMotorConstantPower; NOT served by bulk cache

servo.getPosition.note: returns last commanded value; no feedback

pinpoint.update.note: bulk register read of the odometry computer

lynx.getBulkData.note: one transaction refreshes encoders, velocities, digital, analog, busy for one hub

telemetry.update.note: serialise + enqueue to Driver Station; rate-limited to 4 Hz transmit by default (250 ms)

vision.aprilTagDetections.note: getDetections() returns latest processed frame; processing cost is charged to the vision thread, not the caller

vision.frameProcess.note: AprilTag decimation=2 at 640x480 on Control Hub; charged to virtual vision thread and sets detection latency

opmode.loopOverhead.note: event-loop bookkeeping between loop() calls incl. gamepad copy

compute.note: deterministic: fixed modelled user-code cost per loop() / per opModeIsActive() poll. measured: host thread CPU time x measuredScale (Control Hub Cortex-A53 vs desktop) - not bit-reproducible.
